name: Tokumei Sentai Yuzu Ranger
original_name: 特命戦隊ユズレンジャー
source:
An evil organization “Demagog” endangers peaceful everyday. At the memorial ceremony its member suddenly attacks the attendants. A mysterious girl shows up and passes bracelets to the three female cadets present at the ceremony. With the power of bracelets girls transform to the Rangers able to protect their town from this evil threat.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
邪惡組織「德馬戈格」威脅著和平的日常生活。在紀念儀式上，其成員突然襲擊了出席者。一名神秘少女現身，將手環交給儀式現場的三名女學員。三人藉助手環的力量變身為戰隊成員，獲得了保護城鎮、抵禦邪惡威脅的能力。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
